decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension, replacement of the existing porch, erection of a two storey side extension and conversion of the existing garage to a guest room and a revised parking layout would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbours' living conditions and it therefore complies with the adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), H.6.4 (Extensions and alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 43 Northumberland Avenue.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.30am  to 5.00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.30am to 12.00 noon on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 9 - The vehicle crossover entrance shall be no wider than 3.6m.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected in the rear garden.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the  extensions are used.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, replace existing  porch, erection of two storey side extension and conversion of existing garage to a guest room to house.
